evals.prompt: I need an investor-ready business plan. What goes in it?
evals.expected_output: Follows the ten steps: executive summary last, problem and opportunity, solution, bottom-up market sizing, competitors, business model, go-to-market, team, financial projections, and the funding ask.
assertions: Uses bottom-up market sizing for TAM, SAM, SOM
Analyzes competitors instead of claiming none
Specifies the funding ask and use of proceeds

evals.prompt: Can I say my TAM is $50B because the industry is huge?
evals.expected_output: No. The plan must justify TAM bottom-up with target customers times revenue per customer.
assertions: Multiplies target customers by revenue per customer

evals.prompt: Should I claim we have no competitors?
evals.expected_output: No. Claiming no competitors signals naivety. The plan maps direct, indirect, and substitute competitors.
assertions: Maps direct, indirect, and substitute competitors
Identifies an unfair advantage and barriers to entry
